annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Arms Control and Nonproliferation
key_provisions_or_claims: Declaration provides a normative framework for responsible military use of AI and autonomy
Launched February 2023 at REAIM in The Hague; text released November 2023
Inaugural plenary of endorsing states held March 19-20, 2024
List of endorsing states as of November 27, 2024 (about 58)
US will convene regular dialogue among endorsing states
named_instruments_referenced: Political Declaration on Responsible Military Use of AI and Autonomy
annotation.summary_en: US State Department web page describing the Political Declaration on Responsible Military Use of AI and Autonomy, a non-binding normative framework launched in 2023. It reports the 2024 plenary of endorsing states, lists endorsing countries as of November 2024, and links to the declaration text in several languages.
